canonical_data: agent trajectories, screenshots, sandbox state, computer-use actions, task logs, and evaluation results
current_repo_note: This record covers the MIT-licensed Cua libraries and self-hostable computer-use infrastructure; optional Cua Cloud sandbox capacity is a separate managed service boundary.
strengths: Combines computer-use agent tooling, desktop virtualization, sandbox lifecycle, and evaluation in one reusable stack
Supports local execution and self-hosting while offering optional managed sandbox capacity
SDK and protocol surfaces make the computer boundary usable from multiple agent frameworks
weaknesses: Computer-use reliability still depends on fragile visual interaction and application state
Desktop automation creates a broad credential, privacy, and consequential-action surface
The fast-moving multi-package stack and optional cloud boundary increase operational complexity
why_it_matters: A prominent open implementation of the infrastructure layer needed to test and run agents that operate complete desktop environments rather than only browser APIs.
